events.description: Monica Geller says Monica Geller is using Bactine.
Monica Geller says Bactine will not hurt.
Joey Tribbiani says the substance Joey Tribbiani just used was wax.
Phoebe Buffay says Tooty is scared to death.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay, Monica Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Ross Geller, and Rachel Green should find Tooty's owner.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller, Monica Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, and Rachel Green should put Tooty in the hall.
Rachel Green says Tooty would get trampled if Tooty were put in the hall during the blackout.
